row.team_price_text: Quote-only, flat PEPM (per employee per month) fee
row.evidence: TriNet's IdP integrations are SAML sign-in only (JumpCloud: 'TriNet only supports IdP-initiated SSO', set up via the Custom SSO marketplace tile); no SCIM endpoint into TriNet is documented, and its provisioning features push new-hire accounts out to other apps.
row.notes: New row. TriNet is a PEO / HR source, scored as a provisioning target (rule 3b): no SCIM into TriNet is documented. SSO is a 'Custom SSO' marketplace integration (SAML, IdP-initiated only per JumpCloud); Okta's OIN app is SAML only (read from page markup), no Entra gallery tutorial exists. Outbound: the HR Platform (formerly Zenefits) provisions accounts in Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace and similar, and the TriNet marketplace lists Okta, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace for 'single sign-on and user provisioning' (direction not stated; recorded in fallbacks.other_sync). Pricing is quote-only: PEO is a flat PEPM fee, HR Plus (ASO) is quoted per company. TriNet PEO REST API (OAuth client credentials issued on request) can list and hire employees. Researched the PEO platform; the HR Platform (ex-Zenefits) has its own developer portal and was not researched separately.

plans.price_text: Quote-only; flat PEPM (per employee per month) administrative fee
plans.notes: Fee covers HR technology platform access; benefits costs are separate. Minimum worksite employee count applies (number not published).

plans.name: HR Plus (ASO)
plans.price_text: Quote-only; flat fee per employee per month

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint into TriNet is documented. TriNet is an HR source: its marketplace and HR Platform pages describe pushing new-hire accounts out to other apps and IdPs (outbound, rule 3a/3b). 'false' is by absence, not a vendor statement.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (GET https://api.trinet.com/oauth/accesstoken?grant_type=client_credentials); bearer token, no refresh.

capabilities.notes: 'Users' are TriNet worksite employees: Add Employee is a hire transaction. No terminate/deactivate endpoint is listed on the public summary page.

rate_limits.text: TriNet reserves the right to set a per-client call quota; no number published.

user_api.notes: HRIS employee-data API for the TriNet PEO platform; client credentials are issued by TriNet on request (form + integration specialist). Full specs need a developer login. No plan gate is stated.

okta.notes: OIN 'TriNet' app (last updated Jun. 21 2023) ticks only SAML (read from page markup); no SCIM or provisioning ticks.

entra.notes: No TriNet tutorial in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial list (toc.json checked); trinet-tutorial URL returns 404.

google.notes: Google catalogue not checked; TriNet marketplace lists a Google Workspace integration whose direction is not stated.

onelogin.notes: From TriNet's own marketplace ('for single sign-on'); OneLogin catalogue not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud SAML connector; IdP-initiated only; set up through TriNet's Custom SSO marketplace tile.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: TriNet HR Platform account provisioning to apps (Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace) and marketplace integrations with Okta, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; TriNet is the HR source.
